description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <p>We love pets - which is why we’re on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.&nbsp; We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We’ve helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.&nbsp; Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.&nbsp; Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.&nbsp; Want to join our pack?&nbsp; Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.</p></div><h2>A day in the life</h2> <p>As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.</p> <p>This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.</p> <p>You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.</p> <p>Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.</p> <p>We embrace modern development practices:</p> <ul> <li>All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.</li> <li>We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.</li> <li>We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.</li> </ul> <p>As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <h3>ü&nbsp; Build and maintain secure platform foundations</h3> <ul> <li>Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.</li> <li>Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.</li> <li>Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.</li> <li>Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.</li> <li>Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Make our security controls provable</h3> <ul> <li>Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.</li> <li>Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.</li> <li>Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.</li> <li>Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Strengthen access and identity controls</h3> <ul> <li>Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.</li> <li>Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.</li> <li>Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Extend our platform standards beyond AWS</h3> <ul> <li>Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.</li> <li>Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Team collaboration</h3> <ul> <li>Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.</li> <li>Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.</li> <li>Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.</li> <li>Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.</li> </ul> <h3>ü&nbsp; Self development</h3> <ul> <li>Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.</li> <li>Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.</li> <li>Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.</li> </ul> <h2>Your skills and experience</h2> <p>We are looking for someone with:</p> <ul> <li>Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).</li> <li>Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.</li> <li>A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.</li> <li>Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.</li> </ul> <p>We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:</p> <ul> <li>A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.</li> <li>Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.</li> </ul> <h2>The interview process</h2> <p>This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.</p> <ul> <li>Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.</li> <li>Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.</li> <li>Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.</li> <li>Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular ‘Hack Weeks’ to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we’re interested in and feel passionately about.</p> <h2>Our tech stack</h2> <p>We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.&nbsp; You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.</p> <p>Our “north star” is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.&nbsp; To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.&nbsp; We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.</p> <p>We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.&nbsp; We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.</p> <p>Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Salary range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£55,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£65,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Ways of working</h2> <p>On a typical day you’ll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.&nbsp; You’ll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we’d expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.&nbsp; We’d ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.&nbsp; We’ll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.</p> <h2>Inclusion at ManyPets</h2> <p>We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won’t discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. &nbsp;If you'd like to read more about this, please download our <a href="https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/6htm7c3glth8e7x3sm5xe/Our-Approach-to-Inclusion-Policy-ManyPets-May-24.pdf?rlkey=d0fjswa0v1h6r582kn9mubl9j&amp;st=no0ket4o&amp;dl=0">Approach to Inclusion</a> policy.&nbsp;</p> <h2>Reasonable adjustments and support</h2> <p>If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email <a ---------- If you want to ask any questions or request an adjustment, please let us know and we'll do what we can to flex our approach.</p> <h2>Connect with us!</h2> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/manypets">LinkedIn</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-ManyPets-EI_IE2165347.11,19.htm">Glassdoor</a> | <a href="https://uk.indeed.com/cmp/Manypets/about">Indeed</a> | <a href="https://www.feefo.com/en-GB/reviews/bought-by-many?displayFeedbackType=SERVICE&amp;timeFrame=YEAR">FeeFo</a> | <a href="https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/boughtbymany.com">Trustpilot</a> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/ManyPetsUK">YouTube</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/manypets_UK">Instagram</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.facebook.com/manypetsuk">Facebook</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/manypets_uk">Twitter</a> | <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@manypets_UK">TikTok</a> |&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Security Engineer, Incident Response
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.&nbsp;<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next <strong>Security Engineer, Incident Response</strong></p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) is looking for a Security Engineer who is passionate about solving Twilio’s mission of security and reliability by working across the organization to lead the technical response to security events and incidents across Twilio’s global infrastructure, services and applications by effectively conducting triage, containment, remediation and driving post-incident betterments.&nbsp; You will work within a team that partners with R&amp;D Engineering and R&amp;D Business teams to develop scalable processes and technical solutions.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will be a valued member of a team of deeply technical Security Engineers to focus on creating bespoke and standard Security response processes, enhancing our capabilities for threat mitigation and incident response, and then automating as much as you possibly can (and more)! You will help us to grow our global, scaled team and program.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Lead and support the response to all security events and incidents across Twilio’s complex global infrastructure, services and applications.</li> <li>Be responsible for documentation of incidents and projects you work on and craft best practices as runbooks and standard operating procedures to share knowledge across teams.</li> <li>Work cross-collaboratively to understand and help solve challenges related to a broad spectrum of threat actors and activity.</li> <li>Work to improve Twilio’s security and reliability posture by driving identified betterments from security events and incidents.</li> <li>Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, highly disruptive industry environment.</li> <li>Own the security incident lifecycle, respond to incidents and participate in on-call rotation and participate in RCAs for security incidents.</li> <li>Build, cultivate, and maintain positive relationships with internal customers to identify and facilitate solutions to increase the impact of the team’s work.</li> <li>Provide mentorship, support, and care for the team in a way that enables long-term career development, happiness, and success at scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience: 3+ years of security incident response in a production-cloud environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Subject-matter expert on security issues and technologies</li> <li>Ability to utilize AI for comprehensive, complex security incident response activities delivering high fidelity detections</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of service-oriented architectures, as well as experience with security tools and technologies fit for a cloud environment</li> <li>Experience working across a technology stack on difficult security challenges and initiatives</li> <li>Experience with SIEM platforms and the ability to extend their functionality</li> <li>Experience with SOAR tools and automating manual security processes</li> <li>Experience in either AWS, GCP, or other large cloud platform</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with every level of the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li>AI Model Security &amp; Posture Management: Support Implementation of&nbsp; controls and safeguards to prevent AI vulnerabilities, such as prompt injections, model evasion, and data poisoning</li> <li>AI-Driven Threat Response: Utilize GenAI and LLM-based security use cases to rapidly interpret alerts, reduce false positives, and contextualize threat data</li> <li>Artifact &amp; Evidence Triage: Collects intrusion artifacts and forensically sound images to analyze malware, trojans, and source code.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence Integration: Monitors external vendor data and threat intelligence to analyze trends and proactively defend against emerging risks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote, and based in Ireland or U.K.</p> <p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. raw.description:
About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy.

The team

  • Making the architectural calls that keep our codebase sustainable — improving system health alongside shipping features, not instead of it

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage problem definition; you shape the work rather than wait for a finished spec

  • You treat engineering quality as part of the job - managing technical debt pragmatically, reviewing AI-generated output critically, and pushing for the right architectural decisions under real constraints

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they change the way you work, with the judgment to know when to rely on them and when not to

  • You start from the user problem, not the technology. You know what to build, what not to build, and why. In the AI era, that also means knowing what to delegate, what needs human judgment, and what shouldn't exist at all.

  • You can break ambiguous problems into tractable pieces and see how those pieces connect across boundaries. You spot seams, trade-offs, and second-order effects — thinking both from big to small and small to big.

  • You have strong expertise in at least one area and can use it to build, debug, and improve real systems effectively. You know what “great” looks like in your domain and can reliably get there.

  • You own outcomes, not just tasks. You influence across teams, navigate disagreement to reach the right answer, own your mistakes, and push hard for the wins that matter.

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to fix healthcare communication.

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.


The team

Our engineers have sat in GP waiting rooms. They've watched practice managers juggle three systems at once to send a single message to a patient. They build for that person.

What sets our Product Engineers apart is that they own the problem, not just the code. They shape what gets built and how - working with Product, Design and Clinical from the earliest stages - and they stay with the systems they build as they evolve. They bring engineering judgment into product decisions, and product thinking into engineering ones.

Our stack is primarily C# on the backend, TypeScript and React on the frontend, running on Azure. ML/AI work uses Python. We don't expect you to know all of it - we expect you to follow a problem wherever it leads.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning features end-to-end: from refining the problem with clinicians and product managers through to architecture, implementation, rollout, and long-term evolution

  • Engaging directly with NHS GPs, practice staff and patients to build a genuine understanding of the problems you're solving — research sessions, visiting practices

  • Designing architecture and API boundaries with the broader system in mind, not just the immediate surface

  • Holding the quality bar for what you ship: not just that the code works, but that the product is reliable, intuitive and safe in a clinical context

  • Making the architectural calls that keep our codebase sustainable — improving system health alongside shipping features, not instead of it

  • Pushing back constructively when something is wrong, and committing fully when a decision has been made

What experience you need to be successful

  • Comfortable building production software across the stack - you might be strongest in backend or frontend, but you can follow a problem across both to own a feature end-to-end

  • Proven ability to reason about systems - breaking ambiguous problems into tractable pieces, spotting trade-offs and second-order effects before they become incidents

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage problem definition; you shape the work rather than wait for a finished spec

  • You treat engineering quality as part of the job - managing technical debt pragmatically, reviewing AI-generated output critically, and pushing for the right architectural decisions under real constraints

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they change the way you work, with the judgment to know when to rely on them and when not to

What we’re looking for to demonstrate as a Product Engineer at Accurx

  • You start from the user problem, not the technology. You know what to build, what not to build, and why. In the AI era, that also means knowing what to delegate, what needs human judgment, and what shouldn't exist at all.

  • You can break ambiguous problems into tractable pieces and see how those pieces connect across boundaries. You spot seams, trade-offs, and second-order effects — thinking both from big to small and small to big.

  • You have strong expertise in at least one area and can use it to build, debug, and improve real systems effectively. You know what “great” looks like in your domain and can reliably get there.

  • You own outcomes, not just tasks. You influence across teams, navigate disagreement to reach the right answer, own your mistakes, and push hard for the wins that matter.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to fix healthcare communication.

Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.</li> <li>Previous experience at a top-tier finance <em>or</em> technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.</li> <li>Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have <em>real</em> hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.</li> <li>Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)</li> <li>Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill.&nbsp;</li> <li>If you have management experience, that’s always a bonus – but even so, expect to code!</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). description: <p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£110,000-£150,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>&nbsp; ✨</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the team⭐</strong></p> <p>Core Banking's mission is to make everyday money magical for everyone.</p> <p>We're responsible for the products millions of customers rely on every day — from current accounts, joint accounts and accounts for kids and teens, through to money management, budgeting, and our paid subscriptions. These are some of Monzo's most loved experiences, and they're at the heart of how customers interact with us.</p> <p>As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Senior User Research Manager to help shape the future of Personal Banking. This is an opportunity to lead research across one of Monzo's largest product areas, influence company strategy, and develop exceptional research leaders.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You'll be responsible for both people leadership and strategic research leadership. This includes:</p> <ul> <li>Leading research across Core Banking while helping shape a coherent Personal Banking research strategy that spans multiple product areas.</li> <li>Partnering closely with the Core Banking Leadership Team, Product Directors, Design leaders and senior stakeholders across Wealth, Payments, Borrowing and our European business.</li> <li>Helping define and land parts of Monzo's global research operating model as we expand internationally, ensuring teams work effectively across both global and local markets.</li> <li>Connecting customer insights across collectives, identifying themes, opportunities and gaps rather than viewing research through the lens of a single team.</li> <li>Bringing together existing research, product data, market insights and quantitative evidence to help leadership make informed strategic decisions.</li> <li>Managing managers and supporting approximately 6-8 direct and indirect reports while maintaining a consistently high bar for research quality.</li> <li>Creating an environment where researchers can balance methodological rigour with the speed needed to build great products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>You have experience with:</p> <ul> <li>Leading senior researchers and/or research managers within a complex product organisation.</li> <li>Shaping and influencing product strategy through research at both organisational and executive level.</li> <li>Working across multiple product areas, bringing together disparate customer insights into a coherent strategic narrative.</li> <li>Navigating complex stakeholder environments where different teams have competing priorities, metrics and timelines.</li> <li>Partnering with Product, Design, Engineering and Data Science leaders to influence roadmaps and business strategy.</li> <li>Combining qualitative research with quantitative signals, product data and market insights to develop strategic recommendations.</li> <li>Building alignment across large organisations and landing new ways of working with multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Coaching research leaders while maintaining a high quality bar across multiple teams.</li> <li>Making thoughtful trade-offs between research depth, pace and business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £110,000 - £150,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.&nbsp;</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa.&nbsp;</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)&nbsp;</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.&nbsp;</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.&nbsp;</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <p><strong>Recruiter call (30 minutes):</strong> A conversation with one of our recruiters to learn more about your background, motivations, and what you're looking for next, while giving you the opportunity to learn more about Monzo and the role.<br><strong>Leadership &amp; Ways of Working (45 minutes):</strong> We'll explore your leadership experience, approach to research strategy, and how you raise the research quality bar.<br><strong>Final loop (Total 1hr 30 - 2 hours):</strong> Two interviews covering <strong>Managing Teams &amp; People</strong> and <strong>Leadership &amp; Impact</strong>, where we'll discuss your approach to developing research leaders, building high-performing teams, influencing strategy, and driving organisational impact.</p> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!&nbsp;</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-LG1&nbsp; #LI-Remote</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Level Up Your Career with Zynga!</strong></p> <p>At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.</p> <p>From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires &amp; Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles &amp; Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!</p> <p>Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the play!</p></div><p>We are looking for an ASO &amp; Partnerships leader to drive organic growth and deepen platform relationships for Merge Dragons, Monster Legends, Dragon City, FarmVille titles and many more. This role owns the studio's app store optimization strategy end-to-end and serves as our primary relationship holder with the major app store platforms — Google Play, the Apple App Store, Microsoft Store and Amazon Appstore.</p> <p>You will lead a team responsible for improving organic visibility, store conversion, and featuring, while working closely with Product, Creative, UA, and Data teams to unlock sustainable organic growth and strengthen the top of the funnel. You will mentor and empower the ASO team to deliver best-in-class execution, and you'll be the studio's trusted voice in front of our platform partners.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><em>Strategic Leadership</em></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end ASO strategy for the portfolio, driving organic installs, store conversion, and keyword/category rankings across all markets.</li> <li>Define and manage the yearly organic growth roadmap, including localization, seasonal, and launch strategies.</li> <li>Set the studio's platform partnership strategy, aligning featuring and promotional opportunities with business priorities and release calendars.</li> </ul> <p><em>Platform Partnerships</em></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain strategic relationships with Google Play, Apple App Store, Microsoft Store, and Amazon Appstore partner teams.</li> <li>Secure featuring, editorial placements, and promotional opportunities across launches, updates, and key seasonal moments.</li> <li>Advocate for early access to platform betas, new store features, monetization tools, and APIs, and channel those opportunities back to Product and UA.</li> <li>Represent the studio in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry events, and negotiate co-marketing and joint business plans.</li> </ul> <p><em>Performance Optimization</em></p> <ul> <li>Lead store listing experimentation (Custom Product Pages, Product Page Optimization, Google Play store listing experiments) to improve conversion rate.</li> <li>Own keyword and metadata optimization, and build rigorous test roadmaps across icons, screenshots, preview videos, and descriptions.</li> <li>Establish measurement frameworks to attribute organic uplift and quantify the impact of ASO and featuring initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><em>Team &amp; raw.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Utilities

 

Our tech platform ‘Kraken’ is already licensed to support 90 million customer accounts globally, and we aim to serve 100 million by 2027. Kraken is the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications.

 

We’re now charging the Kraken platform to other utility industries (Water and Broadband) and have created a new team called - Kraken Utilities. Over the last 3 years we have built this team from scratch to re-architect, design, and develop our Kraken software platform to solve complex industry wide problems within the water and broadband sectors (such as customer experience & water leak detection).

 

The Kraken Utilities team is in a very exciting growth phase, and has already signed six key clients: Severn Trent, Leep, Portsmouth Water, Essential Energy, TalkTalk, and Cuckoo. We are currently 120+ people strong globally.

What you’ll do:

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The UK utilities market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • Help build and scale the Kraken utilities team by embedding an engineering, problem solving, and customer-first culture.

  • Architect & develop new components of the Kraken platform to serve other utilities.

  • We have a lot of challenging problems to solve as we work to improve the utilities industry. You will help find the right technology to build complex lifecycle journeys and payment flows, deal with hard industry problems, and support the processing of millions of readings.

  • There's a great opportunity for disruption in the UK water and broadband markets. The landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology.

  • You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our generation arm is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK, and is funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the UK towards a lower carbon future.

What you'll need:

We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful. Experience with the following:

  • Python

  • Django (or equiv. web framework)

  • Domain modelling

  • HTTP and REST APIs

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Celery and async processing

  • Postgres

  • AWS

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About Cinder Cinder is the mission-critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important digital platforms true to what they stand for. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working. Our customers are some of the largest internet platforms in the world. The decisions made in our software directly determine what stays up, what comes down, and how users are treated. We're a small, fast-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems. Why this role Once a deal closes, you're the technical owner on the ground. You're the escalation point for the customer, working closely with their CSM and Agent Product Manager (agent PM), and the first line of engineering defense when something isn't working the way they expect. For some customers, "close" means embedded. You're effectively part of their engineering team, in their Slack, on their calls, building alongside them. The platforms you'd be embedded with have hundreds of millions of users between them. When you fix something, it's not hypothetical. It's live, that day. What you'd actually work on Shape and prove the solution. Work directly with customers to understand their problems, identify the right use cases, and build proofs of concept that demonstrate value and de-risk the path to production. Own deployments end to end. Take the technical work from scoping and system design through implementation, rollout, and adoption — partnering with the CSM while owning the engineering plan. Build the last mile. Connect Cinder to each customer’s stack through APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, custom workflows, and production-quality code where configuration isn’t enough. Enable customer teams. Run technical workshops, document what you build, and give customers the knowledge and tools to operate successfully without us in the room. Turn fieldwork into product leverage. Solve issues in the systems you ship, identify patterns across customers, and turn those lessons into reusable tools and improvements to the core product. Own on-call for customers when system downtime means moderation stops. What we're looking for 4-8 years as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Solid Python fundamentals. You can read, debug, and extend backend code without hand-holding. Comfortability with SQL, Typescript, React, and GraphQL. Real experience owning implementation, not just scoping it. You've configured or customized a product for a specific customer and shipped something that changed what that customer could actually do. You are exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and repeatedly take initiative — you thrive when dropped into unfamiliar situations, learning quickly, and finding ways to deliver value. No degree requirement. We care about what you can build, not where you learned to build it. Bootcamp grads are welcome. Nice to have Understanding of trust & safety or safety operations, either firsthand (you've worked in it) or through a specialized background — a T&S-focused master's, for example — that gives you real fluency, not just familiarity. Consulting experience where you turned a client's ambiguous ask into a working solution. Familiarity with React Query or Strawberry specifically. Experience being embedded with a customer or client team, rather than working at arm's length through tickets. Location & Benefits Our team is based in London and we believe that in-person collaboration is important. We offer medical and dental insurance benefits through Allianz Global. We hold at least two all-company events per year. We offer paid lunch when our team is in-person. Sterling Technology, a subsidiary of TransPerfect, is the leading provider of premium virtual data room (VDR) solutions for the secure sharing of content, business process automation, and collaboration for the M&A, corporate development, real estate, capital markets, private capital, banking, and legal communities. Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centres, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of Sterling’s services

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

  • Promote Sterling by educating clients on the company’s various services

  • Present Sterling via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Provide customer support and manage client expectations

  • Quote, manage, and bill projects daily, coordinating with clients and production teams to ensure these run smoothly and profitably

  • Communicate professionally at all levels of seniority


Essential skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent

  • Excellent written and verbal proficiency in English

  • Minimum of 1- 3 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role

  • Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

  • Strong presentation skills (both in-person and online)

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail

  • Able to prioritise, manage tasks, and work effectively in a team

  • Eager to learn, embrace challenges, and driven to succeed

 

Preferred experience:

  • Experience and/or interest in Financial, Professional, Legal or Technology services

  • Experience and/or interest in the M&A space

raw.title: Senior Medical Writer | UK
raw.description:
We’re seeking an organized, motivated, and collaborative individual for our medical writing team. 

The senior medical writer will partner cross-functionally with client teams in Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory, and Program Management in leading the planning and preparation of high-quality clinical regulatory documents. The medical writer may produce protocols, publications, study reports, investigator brochures, narratives, and module documents, according to client and agency guidelines, to support drug development under brisk timelines. 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the execution of documents, including project management tasks such as creating, maintaining, and communicating timelines 

  • Coordinate cross-functional client contributors and stakeholders as well as internal resources (e.g., quality control [QC], publishing) to ensure timely completion of documents 

  • Ensure document development adheres to any relevant client processes, templates, and instructional documents 

  • Serve as an expert on client document management system and related tools, templates, and procedures to ensure efficient document development  

  • Lead document message development in collaboration with client  

  • Interpret data and create shell documents to support authoring 

  • Plan and lead kickoff meetings  

  • Facilitate resolution of review feedback including planning and leading comment resolution meetings (curate review comments to ensure meetings are efficient)  

  • Follow-up with individual team members as needed to resolve outstanding review feedback 

  • Ensure consistency among client programs in terms of messaging, formatting, and presentation of documents  

  • Conduct literature searches as needed 

  • Perform peer QC review as needed  

  • Contribute to medical writing operational initiatives (e.g., templates, style guides, reference management), if needed 


  • Experience (5+ years) as a medical writer in the CRO/biotech/pharmaceutical field  

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field  

  • Oncology, Infectious Disease, or Vaccine experience desired 

  • Experience desired in writing clinical study reports, protocols, protocol amendments, investigator brochures, module 2, and module 5 documents 

  • Flexibility to work across multiple therapeutic areas, if needed 

  • Experience writing documents according to established processes and document templates 

  • Familiarity with lean authoring approaches and structured content management 

  • Familiarity with the requirements for preparation of key clinical and regulatory documents, including ICH and US regulatory requirements; working knowledge of ex-US regulatory requirements is desired  

  • Expertise with Microsoft Word and other Microsoft applications  

  • Experience developing documents using document management systems, collaborative authoring tools, and review tools 

  • Comfortable adapting to new tools and technologies, if needed 

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in the face of competing priorities  

  • Service-oriented and proactive approach to project management  

  • Excellent conflict management and negotiation skills  

  • Comfortable providing suggestions based on previous experience 

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

TransPerfect provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law

 

For more information on the TransPerfect Family of Companies, please visit our website at www.transperfect.com.

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer - London
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. </span><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. </span><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.</span></p></div><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">ABOUT THE ROLE:</span></h3> <p>We are seeking a talented and motivated Infrastructure Security Engineer to join our security team. In this role, you will design, implement, and maintain secure cloud and hybrid infrastructure, and ensure the integrity of our cloud-native applications.</p> <p>This role focuses on securing critical infrastructure across multi-cloud and hybrid environments, with work that may span platforms such as SpaceXAI, X Social, X Money and related systems. You’ll operate with an automation-first mindset: building secure foundations, hardening platforms at scale, and partnering closely with engineering teams so security is embedded in how we build and run systems—not bolted on after the fact.</p> <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></h3> <p><strong>Cloud &amp; infrastructure security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement secure cloud architectures across multiple cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)</li> <li>Build and secure mission-critical applications in hybrid cloud and on-premises environments</li> <li>Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates with embedded security controls</li> <li>Assist with regular security assessments and audits of cloud infrastructure and services</li> <li>Implement and manage cloud security tools and services (e.g., CSPM, CWPP, CASB)</li> <li>Manage identities and roles effectively across cloud and hybrid environments</li> <li>Monitor and remediate infrastructure to comply with regulations and best practices (e.g., PCI, NIST CSF, GDPR, HIPAA)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Platform, containers &amp; developer enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and implement secure container standards and automation that enable frictionless developer workflows</li> <li>Maintain Kubernetes security aligned with current best practices</li> <li>Collaborate with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated into CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Secure and enhance CI/CD pipelines; integrate and maintain code scanning platforms</li> </ul> <p><strong>Detection, operations &amp; tooling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor and respond to security events and incidents in cloud and hybrid environments</li> <li>Maintain SIEM data pipelines needed for reliable alerting</li> <li>Build, deploy, and maintain security operations infrastructure using Python, Terraform, and configuration management (e.g., Puppet)</li> <li>Develop dashboards and alerts from security metrics</li> <li>Develop and maintain cloud security policies, standards, and procedures</li> <li>Own security projects end to end: identify issues and implement solutions</li> <li>Stay current with emerging cloud security threats and mitigation strategies</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field</li> <li>3–5 years of experience in cloud security, infrastructure security, or related roles</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud security principles, compliance frameworks, and best practices</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and associated security services</li> <li>Proven experience securing hybrid AWS/on-premises (or multi-cloud) environments, including IAM and overall security posture</li> <li>Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation)</li> <li>Familiarity with containerization technologies and their security implications</li> <li>Knowledge of network security concepts and protocols</li> <li>Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation and tool development</li> <li>Proactive mindset with strong ownership, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills</li> <li>Located in the EU/UK or willing to relocate</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Relevant security certifications (e.g., CCSP, CSSK, AWS Security Specialty)</li> <li>Deep expertise in Kubernetes and container security</li> <li>Experience with multi-cloud environments and cloud-to-cloud security</li> <li>Knowledge of CI/CD best practices and tools</li> <li>Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST CSF)</li> <li>Strong proficiency with Python, Terraform, and configuration management (e.g., Puppet)</li> <li>Hands-on experience building GitHub Actions and workflows</li> <li>Experience with observability and security operations tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Karma; SIEM platforms such as Wazuh)</li> <li>Experience in building custom cloud security tools or integrations</li> <li>Interest in leveraging AI for cloud security monitoring and automation</li> <li>Contributions to open-source cloud security projects</li> <li>Experience with securing AI/ML workloads in cloud environments</li> <li>Experience in banking, money transmission, P2P payments, or similarly regulated financial platforms.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. title: Staff Platform Engineer, Infrastructure - Core UK & Ireland
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.&nbsp;</div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming (FBG) is seeking a&nbsp;<strong>Staff Platform Engineer</strong> to join our Platform Engineering team based in the UK or Ireland. This position plays a critical role within the EMEA Platform Engineering organisation, partnering closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and United States to build and operate the platforms that power Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming’s global software ecosystem.<br><br>As a Staff Engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, leading complex technical initiatives across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will influence platform architecture, define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help drive technical design and delivery of core platform capabilities spanning cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, Observability, CI/CD systems, and developer tooling</li> <li>Architect, build, and operate cloud-native platforms on AWS with a focus on reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency</li> <li>Lead the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows.</li> <li>Build and maintain internal platform services and tooling that improve developer experience and delivery velocity</li> <li>Continue to drive Infrastructure as Code and automation practices across teams</li> <li>Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs</li> <li>Participate in and/or lead complex, cross-team initiatives and provide technical clarity in ambiguous problem spaces</li> <li>Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and participate in on-call rotations</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering</li> <li>Proficiency with Python and Java. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Ability to influence without authority and communicate effectively across regions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or portals</li> <li>FinOps or cloud cost management experience</li> <li>Regulated or high-availability environment experience</li> <li>Backend development experience</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Salary Range&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>£121,200 – £151,200 (London)<br>(Salary is determined by location and may vary based on geography)</p> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. Our mission is to empower developers with reliable, scalable, and intuitive platforms that accelerate innovation and delivery.</p> <p><strong>Working Across Regions</strong></p> <p>This role operates in a globally distributed environment, working closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and the United States. Strong communication, time zone coordination, and shared ownership are essential for success.</p> <p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p> <p>We believe great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. We value <strong>impact, technical leadership, and a growth mindset</strong>&nbsp;just as much as specific tool experience.</p> <p>Unfortunately, we do not offer sponsorship and you do need to be living in the UK or Ireland to apply.</p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£111,100</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£138,600 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Join us in building the future of finance.</h2> <p>Our mission is to democratize finance for all. <a href="https://www.cerulli.com/press-releases/cerulli-anticipates-124-trillion-in-wealth-will-transfer-through-2048" target="_blank">An estimated $124 trillion of assets</a> will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.</p></div><h2><strong><span data-markdown-start-index="46">About the team + role</span></strong></h2> <p><span data-markdown-start-index="70">We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. <br><br>The <strong>Custody Services</strong> team is responsible for managing our crypto infrastructure, digital asset custody providers, and the various integrations we maintain with third-parties — from wallet management to crypto infrastructure management! The team is also responsible for processing crypto transactions, as well as products like staking, lending, and travel rule compliance. We currently safeguard billions in assets under custody for millions of customers.</span></p> <p><span data-markdown-start-index="959">As a&nbsp;</span><strong><span data-markdown-start-index="966">Senior Backend Engineer</span></strong><span data-markdown-start-index="991">&nbsp;on this team, you'll work on the infrastructure behind crypto processing, wallet and key management workflows, and our integrations with third-party custodians. Most of what you'll build sits at the boundary between infrastructure and security.</span></p> <p><span data-markdown-start-index="1237">This role is based in our London, UK office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least <strong>3 days per week</strong>.
