title: Senior Treasury Specialist
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Treasury Specialist will support Firmus’ treasury operations across debt facilities, hedging, cash management, bank guarantees, intercompany funding, reporting, controls, and treasury systems implementation.</p> <p>This role is responsible for helping build scalable treasury processes as Firmus grows, ensuring treasury activity is accurately captured, controlled, reported, and aligned with financing, accounting, compliance, and operational requirements.</p> <ul> <li>Debt facility administration, including ongoing management of monthly compliance processes for GPU backed asset financings.</li> <li>FX and interest rate hedging, including confirmation processes, FX and interest rate settlements, hedge accounting support, valuations, and effectiveness testing inputs.</li> <li>Cash management and investments, including short-term liquidity planning, consolidated cash reporting, investments and counterparty exposure monitoring.</li> <li>Treasury systems and automation, including implementation of a treasury management system, automated bank feeds, straight-through processing, and improved treasury controls.</li> </ul> <p>You will work closely with Finance, Legal, Company Secretariat, Operations, and external banking partners to ensure treasury processes are disciplined, accurate, timely, and fit for a fast-growing AI infrastructure business.</p> <p>The role is hands-on and operationally focused, requiring strong attention to detail, control discipline, financial systems capability, and the ability to manage multiple treasury work streams across debt, hedging, cash, reporting, and intercompany activity.</p> <p>This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building robust treasury operations in a high-growth environment and can combine technical treasury knowledge with practical process execution.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Debt Facilities</span></p> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate records of debt facilities, including key terms, rate sets, interest accruals, fee amortisation, ticking fees, and related accounting inputs.</li> <li>Prepare and coordinate monthly compliance processes, covenant reporting, certificates, lender reporting, and ongoing covenant model updates.</li> <li>Coordinate treasury payments for based on debt waterfalls, and manage fees, interest, transfers to and from liquidity accounts, and other facility-related cash movements.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Cash Management &amp; Investments</span></p> <ul> <li>Prepare consolidated cash balance reporting across banking partners, including minimum cash balances required in specific accounts.</li> <li>Responsible for weekly cash flow funding and support medium term cash forecasting, incorporating expected payments, project-level requirements, liquidity needs, and corporate cash views.</li> <li>Management of short term cash investments including term deposits and MMFs.</li> <li>Support ongoing bank KYC requirements in conjunction with Company Secretariat and maintain disciplined records for bank access and authority arrangements.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Hedging</span></p> <ul> <li>Manage day-to-day FX requirements in line with weekly cash flow funding</li> <li>Support the GM Treasury in developing the Group’s hedging strategy.</li> <li>Coordinate FX and derivative confirmations and settlements.</li> <li>Support hedge accounting documentation, valuations, CVA/DVA measurement inputs, and effectiveness testing processes.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Bank Guarantees</span></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate execution, issuance, amendment, tracking, and release of bank guarantees as required by the business.</li> <li>Maintain a bank guarantee register and support accounting for guarantee fees, including upfront fees released to profit and loss over time.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Reporting, Controls &amp; Compliance</span></p> <ul> <li>Prepare monthly treasury and facility reporting, including cash balances, controlled account reconciliations, operating reporting, covenant model updates, and project-level treasury inputs.</li> <li>Support reporting required for customer contracts, lender requirements, equity investor requirements, and SPV funding arrangements.</li> <li>Prepare monthly counterparty credit reporting covering investments, mark-to-market positions, exposures, and treasury counterparty risk.</li> <li>Assist with audit reporting on treasury control and process compliance, including bank platform access reviews and segregation of duties.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">In</span></span><span style="text-decoration: underline;">tercompany &amp; Treasury Systems</span></p> <ul> <li>Support accounting and reporting for cross-entity bank transfers, cross-border balances, and ring-fenced entity balances.</li> <li>Lead or support treasury management system implementation, including facility capture, hedging workflows, valuation and effectiveness testing setup, and treasury reporting.</li> <li>Work with Finance Systems to implement automated bank statements into NetSuite and the treasury management system, and support straight-through processing for AP and treasury payments.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve treasury processes, controls, documentation, automation, and reporting cadence as Firmus scales.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h3> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Required Skills</span></p> <ul> <li>8-10+ years experience in treasury operations, corporate treasury, project finance operations, banking, or a related finance role.</li> <li>Strong understanding of debt facility administration, cash management, payments, bank accounts, covenants, interest accruals, fees, and treasury reporting.</li> <li>Working knowledge of FX, derivatives, confirmations, settlements, hedge accounting support, valuations, and treasury counterparty reporting.</li> <li>Strong financial systems capability, with experience using ERP, banking platforms, treasury management systems, payment automation and AI tools.</li> <li>High attention to detail, strong control mindset, and ability to manage deadlines across multiple workstreams.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with ability to coordinate effectively across Finance, Legal, CoSec, banks, advisors, and internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Preferred Experience</span></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a high-growth infrastructure, technology, energy, data centre, project finance, or listed-company environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with lender reporting, covenant models, controlled accounts, liquidity requirements and intercompany funding.</li> </ul> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Location &amp; Reporting</strong></h3> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1">Location:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> Sydney, Australia</span></li> <li class="li1">Reports to:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> General Manager, Treasure</span></li> </ul> <h3 class="p1">&nbsp;</h3> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Employment Basis</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Permanent full-time</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Diversity</strong></h3> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.</p> <p class="p1">Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Procurement & Supply Chain Compliance Specialist
description: <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></p> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></p> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.</p> <p class="p1">Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.</p> <p class="p1">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Role Summary</strong></span></p> <p>The Procurement &amp; Supply Chain Compliance Specialist is responsible for ensuring the organisation's procurement and supply chain activities are conducted in accordance with legal, regulatory, contractual, ethical and corporate governance requirements. Working within a highly regulated technology environment, the role provides oversight of supplier governance, third-party assurance, procurement compliance, ESG obligations, modern slavery requirements, information security due diligence, operational resilience and supplier assurance activities. The role partners with Procurement, Legal, Risk, Information Security and business stakeholders to ensure suppliers are selected, managed and monitored in a manner that supports organisational objectives while protecting the organisation from operational, financial, reputational and regulatory risk.</p> <p>The position plays a key role in strengthening supplier governance frameworks, improving supply chain transparency and ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory obligations and customer expectations.</p> <p class="p1"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Procurement Governance &amp; Compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of procurement governance frameworks, policies and procedures.</li> <li>Monitor compliance with procurement policies, delegated authorities and sourcing requirements.</li> <li>Review procurement activities to ensure adherence to internal controls and governance obligations.</li> <li>Support procurement assurance reviews and compliance reporting.</li> <li>Provide guidance to business units on procurement governance and compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Supplier Risk Management and Compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate supplier due diligence, risk assessment and compliance activities.</li> <li>Assess suppliers against financial, operational, cyber security, privacy, regulatory and reputational risk criteria.</li> <li>Maintain supplier risk registers and supplier assurance records.</li> <li>Monitor supplier performance and compliance throughout the contract lifecycle.</li> <li>Escalate material supplier risks and compliance issues.</li> <li>Ensure contractual obligations relating to compliance, security and privacy are appropriately managed.</li> <li>Maintain supplier governance documentation and records.</li> <li>Support contract governance and performance management activities.</li> <li>Maintain evidence supporting compliance with procurement and contractual requirements.</li> <li>Assist in resolving supplier compliance issues and non-conformances.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Resilience &amp; Supply Chain Assurance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support supply chain resilience assessments and critical supplier reviews.</li> <li>Identify concentration risks and single points of failure within the supply chain.</li> <li>Assist with business continuity and contingency planning for critical suppliers.</li> <li>Monitor geopolitical, regulatory and market developments impacting supply chain operations.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Skills &amp; raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training - UK
raw.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details: https://www.loom.com/share/b0d1b0bf24c44ae8b95dca84b9db60e5

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

  • Completing the rollout of the next version of our platform while the current one keeps serving live traffic.

  • Moving acquired sites, which currently deploy in their own ways, onto a common build and release path.

  • Strengthening edge protection and resilience so the platform absorbs traffic spikes and hostile traffic.

  • Giving every team clear visibility of what's deployed, when, and how often.

  • Defining the route from prototype to production, including the checks a service needs before it goes live.

What you'll be responsible for

Platform and infrastructure

  • Design, build and run scalable, secure infrastructure on GCP, defined in Terraform.

  • Own networking and IAM design, including VPCs, ingress through Traefik, and encryption of data at rest and in transit.

  • Make and record architecture decisions for the platform, and keep them visible to the wider team.

  • Work with the software engineering team to ensure we’re delivering the right infrastructure at the right time.

  • Work with our data engineers on the infrastructure behind BigQuery and our data pipelines.

Delivery and developer experience

  • Own our CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and make deployments quick and repeatable.

  • Build self-service tooling so product engineers can ship and run their own services with confidence.

Reliability and security

  • Set up monitoring, logging and alerting using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Prometheus and Grafana.

  • Lead root cause analysis after incidents and see the fixes through.

  • Build security into the delivery process early, and track and address vulnerabilities across the estate.

  • Keep the platform in line with our regulatory obligations and internal policies.

Leadership

  • Line manage and develop our infrastructure engineer, with regular one-to-ones and a clear growth plan.

  • Set platform standards and help the iGaming and Rewards tech leads adopt them.

  • Shape the platform roadmap with the Director of Engineering and plan how the team grows.

  • Hire into the platform team as it expands.

About you

  • Significant experience as a platform, cloud or infrastructure engineer, including time as the senior or lead engineer on a team.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with GCP, including GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

  • Strong Terraform skills and experience running infrastructure as code in production.

  • Experience building and running CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitHub Actions.

  • Solid Docker and Kubernetes experience, including cluster networking and ingress.

  • Scripting and programming ability in Python, Go or Bash.

  • Experience with observability tooling and with leading incident response.

  • Experience mentoring engineers, and a real interest in line management.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort explaining technical trade-offs to people outside engineering.

Nice to have

  • TypeScript or JavaScript experience.

  • ArgoCD or other GitOps tooling.

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.

  • Experience consolidating infrastructure after an acquisition or major migration.

  • Experience building or growing a platform team.

Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.</p> <p>As part of Ripple, we're backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.</p> <p>This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.&nbsp;</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do Your Best Work</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.&nbsp; cross-functional alignment across infrastructure boundaries, and raising the bar for engineering rigour and observability practices across the organisation.</p> <h3><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h3> system design.</li> <li>Hands-on engineering experience with inference systems, including batching/micro-batching strategies, caching, memory optimisation, mixed precision (BF16/FP8), and streaming token delivery.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to systematically improve tail latency (P95/P99) and platform reliability through metrics-driven engineering.</li> <li>Proven experience owning system-wide SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, autoscaling strategies, and mentoring senior and mid-level engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct open-source or production contributions to modern inference frameworks (e.g., vLLM, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or TorchServe).</li> <li>Deep experience with GPU systems engineering and hardware performance optimisation description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as&nbsp;<a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign &amp; channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.</p> <p><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role.</strong> You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Core </strong>is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.</li> <li><strong>Borrowing</strong> is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.</li> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Product Marketing for a Product. </strong>You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.</li> <li><strong>Become the expert on your market. </strong>You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning customers understand. </strong>You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.</li> <li><strong>Influence Product Strategy.&nbsp;</strong>You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>Shape successful launches. </strong>You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters. </strong>You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You enjoy owning entire products.</strong> You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>You solve ambiguous problems with evidence.</strong> You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.</li> <li><strong>You know what makes products win.</strong> You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>You influence through collaboration.</strong> You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.</li> <li><strong>You're always improving and helping others improve.</strong> You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins)&nbsp;</li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!&nbsp;</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK&nbsp;</li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences&nbsp;</li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.&nbsp;<br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple clients, competing priorities and statutory deadlines

  • A collaborative, client-first mindset, comfortable working cross-functionally within a scaling business

What We Offer

raw.title: Network Developer
raw.description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

title: Data Engineer
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Data Foundations team ⭐ At Alan, every decision we make about our members' care, contracts and claims is a data decision. The Data Foundations team builds the platform that makes those decisions possible in a safe way. Being part of the Data Foundations team means you’ll build, maintain, and improve the Data Platform used by everyone at Alan. We enable Alan’s data-driven nature and help our colleagues make the most of their data. Partner closely with people across Alan (technical and non-technical) to understand their needs and build data solutions they can trust and use effectively. We own and manage all data-related tools that power Alan. AI is changing the way companies work with data: agents are becoming first-class users of our data warehouse. It opens a world of new usage and exciting features, as well as concerns around security, data quality and governance. We are building the foundations that allow Alan to make the most of this exciting new paradigm. Alan is expanding quickly: we went from 4 to 6 countries this year and we won’t stop there. Our objective is to onboard new countries in weeks, not months. Having strong data foundations is a cornerstone of that expansion , allowing our teams to make sense of a patchwork of insurance systems, regulations and reporting rules. Examples of our missions: improve the developer experience when building and maintaining data pipelines, enable reliable and secure access to our data warehouse for Alaners and AI agents, strengthen security and governance around our data assets, define and implement standard data practices across Alan, maintain and evolve our core data infrastructure to accommodate Alan's international expansion and growing product breadth… Our core tools include Python, Airflow, Snowflake, AWS/GCP, Metabase, Terraform, dbt, and others. Who you'll work with: Data Foundations is a small, high-leverage team inside the Tech Foundations area, whose mission is to enable product crews through world-class infrastructure, developer experience, operational excellence, and built-in security. You'd be joining as one of its core engineers, working daily with the whole Data community at Alan. 🎯 Expected skills and abilities You would thrive at Alan if most of this sounds like you: Passionate about owning ambitious problems and developing simple solutions for them. 3+ years of experience demonstrating impact in Data positions. We welcome candidates from early-career to highly experienced profiles. You may already have strong expertise in Data Engineering, or be an experienced data or software engineer looking to deepen your specialization in this area. Experience building and operating production data infrastructure : orchestration (Airflow or similar), a cloud data warehouse, infrastructure as code. Experience designing systems, tools or libraries used by other engineers, scientists or analysts . Proficient in Python and SQL. Setting a high standard of rigor and precision for yourself, interested in your craft. Curious about AI and eager to use it thoughtfully to increase your impact. Great listening and communication skills. Humble, kind, collaborative, and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!). Fluent and clear in English, both oral and written (no need to speak French!). For this role, we are looking to hire within the C0-E level range . ⚙️ Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you . Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learning or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. raw.title: Data Engineer
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Data Foundations team ⭐

At Alan, every decision we make about our members' care, contracts and claims is a data decision. The Data Foundations team builds the platform that makes those decisions possible in a safe way.

  • Being part of the Data Foundations team means you’ll build, maintain, and improve the Data Platform used by everyone at Alan.

  • We enable Alan’s data-driven nature and help our colleagues make the most of their data.

  • Partner closely with people across Alan (technical and non-technical) to understand their needs and build data solutions they can trust and use effectively.

  • We own and manage all data-related tools that power Alan.

  • AI is changing the way companies work with data: agents are becoming first-class users of our data warehouse. It opens a world of new usage and exciting features, as well as concerns around security, data quality and governance. We are building the foundations that allow Alan to make the most of this exciting new paradigm.

  • Alan is expanding quickly: we went from 4 to 6 countries this year and we won’t stop there. Our objective is to onboard new countries in weeks, not months. Having strong data foundations is a cornerstone of that expansion, allowing our teams to make sense of a patchwork of insurance systems, regulations and reporting rules.

  • Examples of our missions:

    • improve the developer experience when building and maintaining data pipelines,

    • enable reliable and secure access to our data warehouse for Alaners and AI agents,

    • strengthen security and governance around our data assets,

    • define and implement standard data practices across Alan,

    • maintain and evolve our core data infrastructure to accommodate Alan's international expansion and growing product breadth…

  • Our core tools include Python, Airflow, Snowflake, AWS/GCP, Metabase, Terraform, dbt, and others.

  • Who you'll work with: Data Foundations is a small, high-leverage team inside the Tech Foundations area, whose mission is to enable product crews through world-class infrastructure, developer experience, operational excellence, and built-in security. You'd be joining as one of its core engineers, working daily with the whole Data community at Alan.

🎯 Expected skills and abilities

You would thrive at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • Passionate about owning ambitious problems and developing simple solutions for them.

  • 3+ years of experience demonstrating impact in Data positions. We welcome candidates from early-career to highly experienced profiles. You may already have strong expertise in Data Engineering, or be an experienced data or software engineer looking to deepen your specialization in this area.

  • Experience building and operating production data infrastructure: orchestration (Airflow or similar), a cloud data warehouse, infrastructure as code.

  • Experience designing systems, tools or libraries used by other engineers, scientists or analysts.

  • Proficient in Python and SQL. Setting a high standard of rigor and precision for yourself, interested in your craft.

  • Curious about AI and eager to use it thoughtfully to increase your impact.

  • Great listening and communication skills.

  • Humble, kind, collaborative, and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).

  • Fluent and clear in English, both oral and written (no need to speak French!).

For this role, we are looking to hire within the C0-E level range.

⚙️ Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learning or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Strategic Partner Account Manager DACH
description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems. As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region. Key Responsibilities: Partner Recruitment & Onboarding: Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets. Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity. Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes. Partner Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities. Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans. Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement: Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets. Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral. Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners. Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution. Forecasting & Reporting: Accurately forecast partner sales and contribute to overall company revenue projections. Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management. Program Development & Optimization: Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the channel partner program, including policies, incentives, and marketing initiatives. Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements. Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in channel management Qualifications: Confident Communicator. Languages: Native German language, English fluent.  You have at least 2-3 years of experience, ideally in partnership development, in a competitive, data-driven environment.  You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and an interest in technology Analytical and strategic thinking abilities, KPI driven approach. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field. Why join us? 🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities 💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall 📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit 🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset 💶 Competitive salary package & benefits DE&I Statement:  At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.  We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.   We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn. Want to know more about candidate privacy? Find our Candidate Privacy Notice here. CONTEXTE

Au sein de la DSI Marchés de Capitaux d'une grande banque d'investissement, vous rejoindrez l'équipe en charge d'une plateforme Web internationale dédiée au pilotage des activités de Crédits Structurés et de Titrisation.

Cette application critique permet d'assurer, à l'échelle mondiale, le suivi des résultats financiers, la gestion des risques de marché, la réalisation des transactions complexes (deals) ainsi que la garantie de la qualité des données décisionnelles. Dans le cadre de l'évolution de la plateforme et de l'augmentation des volumétries, nous recherchons un Développeur Fullstack confirmé.

 
 
DESCRIPTIF DE MISSION 
 

En tant que Développeur Fullstack au sein d'une équipe Agile, vous participerez activement à la conception, au développement et au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l'application Web. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement collaboratif en interaction directe avec les équipes métiers, la production et les autres entités IT.

  • Qualité & Tests : Appliquer les meilleures pratiques de développement (approche TDD, tests unitaires) et assurer l'intégration continue.

  • Support : Assurer le support N2/N3 fonctionnel et technique auprès des utilisateurs et des équipes opérationnelles.


Profil recherché 🔎

  • Compétences techniques (Stack) :

    • Maîtrise de l'écosystème .NET : C#, .NET, Web API, WCF.

    • Maîtrise des technologies Front-end : Angular.

    • Solides compétences en bases de données : SQL.

    • DevOps, Qualité & Méthodologie :

      • Pratique avérée du TDD (Test Driven Development) et des frameworks de tests (NUnit).

description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process. Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets. Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development. Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
raw.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge &amp; Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Business Acumen &amp; AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical &amp; Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication &amp; Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred..&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning &amp; Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Über die Stelle

Als Solution Engineer bei gateB übersetzt du komplexe Kundenanforderungen in tragfähige technische Lösungen. Du verbindest Beratung, Technologie und Umsetzung und begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen. 

Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen nationalen und internationalen Projekten. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee über erste Prototypen und Pilotlösungen bis zur produktiven Einführung. Du übernimmst technische Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Consultants, Entwicklungsteams und Technologiepartnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Lösungen termingerecht, qualitativ hochwertig und mit erkennbarem Kundennutzen umgesetzt werden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Kundenanforderungen sowie Erarbeitung von Systemkonzepten und Lösungsdesigns im direkten Austausch mit Kunden und internen Projektteams
  • Konzeption von Workflows, Customer Journeys, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen sowie Erstellung umsetzbarer Briefings für Entwicklung und Implementation
  • Technische Konzeption, Spezifikation und Umsetzung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Partnertechnologien wie BSI und Salesforce sowie von gateB-eigenen Lösungen
  • Konfiguration und Implementierung von Cloud- und Enterprise-Lösungen einschliesslich Reports, Systemmasken, Daten- und Metadatenmodellen, Benutzerverwaltungen und Geschäftslogiken
  • Erstellung von Proof-of-Concepts und Minimum Viable Products, Unterstützung bei Aufwandsschätzungen sowie Begleitung von Daten-, Content- und Systemmigrationen und Integrationen
  • Übernahme der technischen Verantwortung und der Funktion als primäre technische Ansprechperson in Implementierungsprojekten sowie Sicherstellung von Zeit, Budget, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Koordination interner Entwicklungsteams sowie von Projektmitarbeitenden bei Partnern und Kunden; Sicherstellung von Testing, Qualitätssicherung, technischer Dokumentation, Schulungen und System-Roll-outs
  • Proaktive Ressourcenplanung, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Engpässen und kostenbewusste Beratung in der Umsetzung
  • Unterstützung des Sales-Prozesses durch RFIs, RFPs und Sales-Demos sowie Beobachtung und Einordnung neuer Technologien und Partnerlösungen im Hinblick auf Machbarkeit und Kundennutzen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung deines Know-hows, aktiver Wissenstransfer ins Team und zu unseren Kunden sowie Mitgestaltung von Software-Partnerschaften im Bereich AI und Enterprise Software


Dein Profil

  • Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang; alternativ eine technische Grundausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementation und Konfiguration von Enterprise-Software-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- oder Content-Plattformen – idealerweise auf Dienstleisterseite
  • Praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Verständnis für die Anwendung von AI-Technologien und deren Integration in Geschäftsprozesse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kundenanforderungen, Systemdesign, Schnittstellen, Datenflüssen und Qualitätssicherung sowie Erfahrung mit Aufwandsschätzungen, technischer Dokumentation und interdisziplinärer Projektarbeit
  • Beratungs- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit tiefem technischem Verständnis, hoher technischer Affinität und Begeisterung für AI
  • Kundenorientierter, eigeninitiativ handelnder und lernfreudiger Umsetzer mit pragmatischer Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Kommunikationsstark, zugänglich und souverän im Auftreten – mit der Fähigkeit, Vertrauen bei technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern aufzubauen
  • Analytische, konzeptionelle und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Verbindlichkeit in Koordination, Priorisierung und Umsetzung
  • Flexibel, reisefreudig und offen für die Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte bei nationalen und internationalen Topkunden mit technisch hochstehenden Systemen
  • Möglichkeit, AI, digitale Transformation und Customer Experience bei Kunden wirksam zu verbinden
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Freiheit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gateB aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit und interkultureller Austausch
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Steinhausen/Zug mit sehr guter Autobahn- und ÖV-Anbindung

title: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.</p></div><p class="wnfdnte" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.</p> <p class="wnfdnte">This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.</p> <p class="wnfdnte">We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.</p> <p class="wnfdnte">&nbsp;</p> <p class="wnfdnte"><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.</li> <li>Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.</li> <li>Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.</li> <li>Skilled in coverage-driven verification and confident debugging across RTL, testbench, and workload scenarios.</li> <li>Motivated by AI hardware and eager to learn verification strategies for new architectures and domains.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Need</strong></p> <ul data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="1" data-border-radius-top-cap="0" data-border-radius-bottom-cap="0"> <li>Contribute to verification of Tensix IP and subsystems from early planning through tape-out, owning coverage goals and driving them to closure.</li> <li>Build and maintain reusable verification environments, agents, scoreboards, and supporting infrastructure in SystemVerilog and Python.</li> <li>Develop constrained-random and directed tests and close functional, code, and assertion coverage using data-driven approaches.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across RTL and testbench while collaborating with design, firmware, compiler, and architecture teams.</li> <li>Help evolve DV infrastructure including regression flows, CI/CD integration, EDA compute environments, and reproducible setups.</li> <li>Nice to have: Exposure to functional safety (FuSa) verification concepts for automotive AI workloads.</li> <li>Nice to have: Familiarity with formal verification methodologies, SVA (SystemVerilog Assertions), or formal property verification for complex control logic and microarchitectural corner cases.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Will Learn</strong></p> <ul data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="1" data-border-radius-top-cap="0" data-border-radius-bottom-cap="0"> <li>How Tenstorrent verifies AI-native compute architectures including Tensix cores, RISC-V CPUs, matrix units, vector units, and datapath.</li> <li>How simulation, emulation, and software-driven workloads combine to validate both functional correctness and performance.</li> <li>How numerical precision formats such as BF16, FP4, and INT8 and on-chip dataflow impact verification complexity and coverage strategy.</li> <li>How to build scalable DV infrastructure across hybrid compute environments including containerized regression systems.</li> <li>How data analytics and modern AI tooling can enhance verification workflows and accelerate convergence.</li> </ul> <p class="wnfdnte">&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div> <p><em>Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets.
